declaration.declared_after: the returns-free coverage, pairing and integrity audit (data/runtime/strategy_g_candidate/coverage_audit.json): bar counts, anchor availability and traded value only
declaration.declared_before: any G0 feature value, label, baseline, bucket, hypothesis result, bootstrap or cost figure was computed
declaration.question: Using only DAY T 16:00-20:00 ET after-hours price and volume structure (plus DAY T regular-session context), can the stocks that make a large upward move in the DAY T+1 premarket be selected statistically?
declaration.promotion_claim: PASS means only that an after-hours -> next premarket Strategy G research track is worth opening. It is not a trading rule, not a paper-trading approval and not an execution claim.
declaration.independence: G is a separate candidate. Strategy F (regular -> same-day after-hours) is not found in this repository; no F file, feature, threshold or result enters G, and no G result is to be used for F. A and E rules, papers, cost assumptions, gates and runtime are not touched.

frozen_inputs.daily_loader: app.backtest.strategy_e0_overnight.dataset.load_daily_rows (imported unmodified; it imports app.backtest.strategy_d_analog.source.load_daily_history unmodified, which verifies every frozen file against its sha256)
frozen_inputs.daily_loader_declaration: e0_overnight_rules_v1.json canonical 078aa79231f075a4eee33ff7924dc6185c23b389ab69b1e0c3d0cc92cfb38752; G reuses only the PIT universe machinery and requires its parameters to equal the G universe values below at runtime

grid.usable_source_sessions: 2024-10-15..2026-09-15 (480; the first 20 are the liquidity warmup and the last has no T+1 on the grid)

minute_sources: Drive common raw pages market_data/raw/massive/minute (3,889 symbol folders)
Drive legacy normalized Parquet market_data/normalized/minute/massive (read by the E0 loader, which prefers it over raw for a session both carry)
USB-HIST-V2 local staging data/runtime/common_hist/v2_staging (174 symbols A..AMSWA, two-year window, all ledgers COMPLETE); used only for sessions the Drive tape does not carry
frozen_inputs.minute_sources_excluded: market_data/forward/massive (Strategy E-MAX forward evidence, sessions after the grid) is not read
frozen_inputs.no_new_collection: G0 issues no provider API call and takes no writer lock

coverage_audit_facts.sample_concentration: 2026Q2+2026Q3 hold 73% of paired PIT rows (broad minute collection starts 2026-04-20); earlier quarters are the 30-symbol V1 tape plus the 174-symbol staging

information_cutoff.signal_information: DAY T bars with start <= 19:59 ET (after-hours window 16:01-19:59) and DAY T daily values known at the T close
information_cutoff.excluded_from_features: every bar of DAY T+1 (premarket included) and any bar of T after 19:59; next-premarket confirmation is not part of G0
information_cutoff.closing_cross_bar: the 16:00 ET bar carries closing-cross prints (coverage: AAPL median 16:00 volume 672k vs 5k at 16:01) and is excluded from every after-hours feature; its traded value is reported separately
information_cutoff.reference_price: official close of T from the frozen grouped daily panel
information_cutoff.price_at_clock_time: close of the last after-hours print at or before that time; with no print since 16:01 the official close is carried

source_session: DAY T, an XNYS session on the frozen grid that is not an early close
target_session: DAY T+1 = MarketCalendar().next_trading_day(T) (exchange_calendars XNYS); the grid successor must equal it or the study stops
weekend_policy: Friday -> Monday pairs are INCLUDED in the primary and reported separately as weekend_gap
holiday_policy: pairs spanning a weekday holiday are INCLUDED in the primary and reported separately as holiday_gap
corporate_action_policy: a split executing in (T, T+1] (split factor at T+1 differs from T in the frozen splits) excludes the row; a FIGI change for the ticker between the CS snapshots as of T and as of T+1 (ticker reuse or change) excludes the row; listing/delisting boundaries are handled by requiring CS membership at T, a daily open at T+1 and a T+1 entry print. Every exclusion is counted and reported; nothing is adjusted silently.
early_close_policy: source sessions that close at 13:00 (5 on the grid) are EXCLUDED: the 16:00-20:00 window is not their after-hours

primary.label: E0800:0925:R
primary.entry_price: open of the first T+1 print in [08:00, 08:14] (bar start)
primary.exit_price: close of the last T+1 print in [entry bar, 09:24], i.e. the price as of 09:25; the entry bar itself counts
primary.basis: 08:00 is kept as the prompt's candidate: coverage shows 07:00 no better (46.8% vs 47.0% within 15m) and 04:00 worse (42.2%); a 15-minute entry window because the exact 08:00 bar exists on only 25.5% of rows. Frozen before any return.

secondary_diagnostics.rule: diagnostics only. The primary is not re-chosen after seeing which entry or exit performs best, and no diagnostic can produce a PASS.

daily_pit.membership: ticker in the latest CS reference snapshot dated on or before T (ETF, fund, warrant, unit and test symbols are excluded by the CS reference)
daily_pit.dollar_volume_window: median close*volume over [T-20, T-1], at least 15 sessions present
daily_pit.corporate_action_exclusion: rows with a split executing in (T, T+1] are excluded and counted (split factor changes between T and T+1)

universe.identity_guard: rows whose FIGI in the latest CS snapshot as of T differs from the one as of T+1 are excluded and counted (ticker reuse / change between the two sessions)
universe.duplicates: identical duplicate minutes are dropped to one copy; a symbol-day with conflicting duplicates is excluded; both counted

after_hours_requirements.basis: three prints is the minimum that defines an after-hours range and a last price (median after bars 16:01-19:59 is 3); the $10k floor removes only token prints (130,092 of 132,123 rows with >= 3 bars keep it). Chosen from counts only.

universe.next_premarket_requirement: an entry print exists on T+1 in the primary entry window. This is a label-existence filter (not knowable at T 20:00); the share of signal rows without it is reported per hypothesis as the fill rate
not_available: ticker-change event table (the FIGI guard is used instead)

feature_definitions.after_dollar_volume: sum of vwap*volume 16:01-19:59 (close when vwap is missing)
feature_definitions.after_rvol: after_dollar_volume / mean after_dollar_volume over the previous 20 grid sessions on which the symbol has a tape (a tape session without an after print counts 0); undefined with fewer than 10 such sessions or a zero mean. Dollar volume is split-invariant.
feature_definitions.after_high / after_low: max high / min low of 16:01-19:59 prints, extended to include close(T)
feature_definitions.position_in_after_range: (P(20:00) - after_low) / (after_high - after_low); undefined when the range is zero
feature_definitions.after_peak_retention: (P(20:00) - close(T)) / (after_high - close(T)); undefined when after_high == close(T)
feature_definitions.regular_rvol: E0 rvol at T (volume / median of the prior 20 sessions, split-normalized)
feature_definitions.close_vs_regular_vwap: close(T) / regular-session VWAP from 09:30-15:59 minute bars - 1
feature_definitions.position_in_regular_range: E0 clv at T = (close - low) / (high - low)
feature_definitions.availability: all of the above read only DAY T data up to 19:59 ET and daily values through T; the after_rvol denominator reads strictly earlier sessions

labels.MFE: max high over [entry bar, exit last bar] / entry_price - 1
labels.MAE: min low over [entry bar, exit last bar] / entry_price - 1
labels.after_close_to_entry: entry_price / P(20:00 of T) - 1 (the move already made before the entry)
labels.execution_limitation: prints, not fills. No quote, spread or depth is available; no number is a net return except the declared cost grid

buckets.note: fixed edges declared before any result; the purpose is monotonicity and distribution/tail shift, not threshold search

H2: After Volume Continuation: after_return_1600_2000 > 0 and after_rvol >= 3.0
H3: Sustained After Strength: after_return_1600_2000 > 0 and position_in_after_range >= 0.8 and last30m_after_return > 0
H4: Regular + After Confirmation: relative_strength_vs_spy > 0 and after_return_1600_2000 > 0 and after_peak_retention >= 0.8
H5: Aggressive After Tail: after_return_1600_2000 >= 0.02 and after_rvol >= 3.0 and distance_to_after_high >= -0.01 and last30m_after_return > 0

hypotheses.thresholds_basis: domain values on declared bucket edges: 0.5% / 1% from the after high is 'near the high', RVOL 3 is the conventional unusual-volume cut, 0.8 of range / retention is 'held most of the move', 2% is a strong after-hours move for a $5+ liquid stock. No optimizer, no sweep.

cost.definition: round-trip cost in basis points of entry notional, subtracted once per trade from the gross return (entry + exit together)
cost.break_even_cost_bp: gross mean return of the candidate in bp
cost.basis: premarket spreads are wider than the regular-session costs used by E (E's cost contract is not used); 50bp round trip is declared as the realistic stress point

bootstrap.method: two-way cluster bootstrap: whole source sessions and, separately, whole tickers are resampled; candidate and baseline are recomputed on the same drawn clusters; the gate reads the weaker (lower) of the two 95% intervals
bootstrap.reason: rows of one evening share the market move, rows of one ticker share its news and float; naive IID over symbol-sessions would overstate precision on both axes
bootstrap.reused: app.backtest.strategy_e0_overnight.stats.session_bootstrap is the same session-cluster design; G's implementation adds the symbol axis and tail metrics

bootstrap_method: two-way cluster (session and symbol), 10,000 resamples, seed 20260927, weaker interval gates

neutralization.method: coarsened exact matching with the E1-H5 estimators imported unchanged (app.backtest.strategy_e1_h5_confirm.matching.session_demeaned as primary, same_session as secondary). Infrastructure only: no E threshold or rule is used.
neutralization.premarket_liquidity_note: T+1 premarket traded value from 04:00 to the entry minute is known at the entry time; it is a control, never a signal feature
outputs: balance (bucket shares of candidate vs control)

neutralization_method: session-demeaned coarsened exact matching on price x regular dollar volume x after dollar volume x pre-entry premarket dollar volume

regime.volatility: cross-sectional median of 20-session realized daily volatility through T, split at its own median
regime.risk_on: share of daily PIT universe rows with regular_day_return > 0 at T >= 0.5 (risk-on) vs < 0.5
regime.use: diagnostic only; no regime is added to a hypothesis

event_classification: UNAVAILABLE: the only event store (SEC EDGAR, C-E0) covers the Strategy C candidate CIKs only; no earnings/guidance/offering/FDA/M&A/news classification exists for the G universe and none is fetched

pass_gate.evaluated_on: E0800:0925:R, each of H1..H5 separately; PASS if at least one hypothesis meets all twelve

bootstrap.rule: the lower of the session-cluster and symbol-cluster 95% CI lows

execution.entry_fill_rate: signal rows with a primary entry print / all signal rows of the hypothesis

pass_gate.verdict_rule: PASS: some hypothesis meets all 12. INCONCLUSIVE: some hypothesis meets 1-11 but not 12 (statistical pass, execution inconclusive), or meets the sample criterion with the weaker bootstrap mean-lift CI low > 0 and a positive gross mean. FAIL otherwise. The gate is not relaxed after results.

fail_policy: on FAIL the G0 study ends. No re-tuning on this data (RVOL, entry/exit minute, range cut). A new structural idea is recorded as NEW CANDIDATE IDEA only.
